classification.difficultyReason: Apply the taught half-cylinder decomposition, halve the supplied diameter, and include both end areas, the curved surface and the rectangular cut face.

content.prompt: Find the surface area of each of these half cylinders:

spec.description: Upright closed half-cylinder with semicircular ends and rectangular diameter cut face. Decorative blue fill omitted.

answer.worked:
The two semicircular ends form one circle. Include the rectangular cut face.
$$\begin{align*}r&=4\div2=2\,\mathrm{m}\\A&=\pi r^{2}+\pi rh+2rh\\A&=\pi(2)^{2}+\pi(2)(6)+2(2)(6)\\A&=4\pi+12\pi+24\\A&=(24+16\pi)\,\mathrm{m}^{2}\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Upright closed half-cylinder with semicircular ends and rectangular diameter cut face. Decorative blue fill omitted.

answer.worked:
The two semicircular ends form one circle. Include the rectangular cut face.
$$\begin{align*}r&=3\div2=\frac32\,\mathrm{m}\\A&=\pi r^{2}+\pi rh+2rh\\A&=\pi\left(\frac32\right)^{2}+\pi\left(\frac32\right)(5)+2\left(\frac32\right)(5)\\A&=\frac{9\pi}{4}+\frac{15\pi}{2}+15\\A&=\left(15+\frac{39\pi}{4}\right)\,\mathrm{m}^{2}\end{align*}$$
